rubrics.justification: Accurately identifies a poor-quality early blastocyst consistent with 1DD, with poorly defined/degenerative ICM and sparse irregular TE. Minor overreach includes precise blastocoel percentage and speculative comments not directly visible from a single image.
Thoroughly integrates age 42, very low AMH, prior IVF outcomes, uterine factor, endometrial thickness, BMI, and semen parameters with embryo quality and prognosis.

Overall logic is clear and consistent, and the low implantation estimate follows from poor morphology plus advanced maternal age. Minor issues include some speculative statements about uterine receptivity and calling trilaminar appearance implied when not provided.

Core assessment and recommendation to consider transfer are broadly aligned, but several adjuncts (routine intensified luteal support, EmbryoGlue emphasis, growth hormone, DHEA/testosterone, low-dose aspirin, prophylactic salpingectomy framing) go beyond or are not strongly supported by standard evidence-based guidelines.

Provides clear practical next steps for transfer counseling, transfer approach, luteal support considerations, uterine evaluation, and future-cycle options including PGT-A and donor oocyte counseling.
